question: One pipe can fill a tank in 6 minutes, while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 15 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-half of the tank?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net work = 1/6 − 1/15 = (5 − 2)/30 = 1/10

Full tank = 10 min

Half tank = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 min

**∴ Answer = 5 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Fill pipe = 6 min, Empty pipe = 15 min
